snippet.title: PATHOGEN-X "Arcade Mode" Official Trailer - Resident Evil Inspired Action-Shooter
snippet.description:
[Play the free demo] sodaraptor.itch.io/pathogen-x

Pathogen-X is a return to the classic action-survival horror genre, inspired by games from the late 90's such as Dino Crisis, Resident Evil, and Deep Fear.

Currently in development by a team of two people, the full experience of Pathogen-X will contain an in-depth story/campaign mode, as well as a more refined version of Arcade Mode with additional content.

Music credit:
Prelude and Action by Kevin MacLeod
Link: https://incompetech.filmmusic.io/song/4236-prelude-and-action
License: https://filmmusic.io/standard-license
